name: Leak detection (CPM, fibre optic DAS and DTS)
aliases: Leak detection (CPM, fibre optic DAS and DTS)
principle: Computational pipeline monitoring (API 1130) and external fibre-optic sensing detect and locate leaks. Distributed acoustic sensing supports negative-pressure-wave and acoustic CPM, and Raman DTS locates leaks to 0.5 m to a few metres over up to 50 km of fibre.

process_steps.name: Sensors measure pressure, flow or fibre response
Algorithm detects and locates the event

performance.basis: depends on measurement time and fibre length
